findings.rationale: The agent read the diff output as a 'single 37-nt insertion' even though the same output showed len(out)-len(inp)=39 and a prefix(215)+suffix(3378) that overlaps the 3591-nt input by 2 nt, i.e. an ambiguous insertion boundary. It recomputed the insert as 39 nt at step 7 and confirmed placement by reconstruction at step 9, so the misreading did not propagate.

The agent fixes its construction as 'forward primer = I + right_anneal; reverse primer = revcomp(I) + revcomp(left_anneal)', putting the entire 39-nt insert on both back-to-back primers; with the Q5 amplify-then-blunt-ligate mechanism this yields a product carrying I at both ends, so circularization inserts two tandem copies rather than the single copy the observed output sequence contains. The inference that this pair converts input to output is invalid against the sequences already observed, and it is never revisited.

primers.fasta is written with forward = I + 17-nt anneal and reverse = revcomp(I) + revcomp(43-nt anneal), both carrying the full insert, so the deliverable encodes a 78-nt tandem duplication instead of the requested 39-nt insertion; the insert should have been placed once (on one primer, or split between the two 5' tails).

The verification script only re-checks the constraints the agent itself imposed (anneal lengths 17/43, Tm 63.28/63.35, delta-Tm) and never simulates the PCR/ligation product of the two primers; the 'reconstruct==output: True' check at step 9 tests only that inserting I once at position 215 gives the output, which is independent of the primer design, yet it is reported as confirmation of the design.

notes: A correct solution had to design one primer pair whose extension products, after Q5 amplification and blunt-end ligation, add the 39-nt insert exactly once at position 215, with annealing regions of 15-45 nt and matched oligotm Tms. The agent correctly located the insertion, installed the ground-truth oligotm binary, and searched the Tm space, but at step 7 it committed to placing the full insert on the 5' tail of both primers, which duplicates the insert in the circularized product; that design was written to primers.fasta at step 9 and never re-examined. This is material because the deliverable would not produce the requested output plasmid, and the step-10 verification checked only length/Tm rules while treating an unrelated reconstruction check as validation of the design.
